7a

The satellite is in circular motion, its velocity is changing, so the satellite is accelerating.

Since the satellite is accelerating, the net force on the satellite is not zero.

The velocity and the acceleration are perpendicular to each other, so the net force (centripetal force) must point towards the centre of the circle, otherwise the satellite would not remain on a circular path.

question.html:
A satellite is orbiting a planet in a circular orbit. The distance between the satellite and the centre of the planet is km and the mass of the planet is kg. 

a. Explain why there needs to be a centripetal force in order for the satellite to move in a circular orbit.

   [2]

b. Find the gravitational field strength due to the planet at the position of the satellite. State an appropriate unit with your answer.

   [2]

c. Calculate the angular velocity of the satellite. 

    [2]
